summary: Defined the colored additive decomposition operad on positive rationals: every three-unit-fraction decomposition factors through a rational two-term residual, but unit-fraction-only binary refinements require a mergeable pair. CERTIFIED: complete enumeration for all 9592 primes p≤100000 gives 1687648 unordered ES triples, all rational-binary composites, of which exactly 531409 are unit-only binary composites. For all 4783 primes p≡1 mod4, none of the 572425 triples is unit-only binary composite; PROVED by the absence of positive two-term decompositions of 4/p. Small-prime counts, mergeability, and graph determinants independently agree with existing brute enumeration through p≤200.
not_done: No claim that general rational binary operations construct previously unknown ES triples; their factorization is tautological.
next: Do not pursue the unrestricted operad as an existence argument without additional effective generators.
